title: Cover letter frontmatter (users/<slug>/applications/<job_id>/letter.md)
description: The YAML frontmatter of a cover letter; the markdown body is the letter. Every factual claim in the body rests on the facts listed in source_facts, validated like CV bullets: they must exist, and an approved letter may cite only verified facts. Approval is the user's act.

headline.description: Shown under the name in the letter header; usually the CV headline

created.description: Printed as the letter's date, in the letter's language
